declaredBefore: the 10 probes and this rule were written before any model ran
question: does the model keep a necessary state relation (缠/挂/系/套/盖/插/搭/卡) between two objects, or does it drop the relation and keep only the entities
declaration: for the 8 relation probes the relation is part of the fact value: it says how the two objects are joined, so omitting it changes the fact. It is NOT treated as an omittable modifier. The two controls say adjacency and soaking; there the relation must NOT be replaced by an attachment

judge.relationProbe: retained if the declared relation token appears; dropped if both entities appear but no relation token; distorted if a different attachment token appears instead
judge.control: clean if no attachment token appears; invented if one does
judge.fact: frozen cf24 scorer for coverage, reported separately

decideBeforeRun: if moved drops the relation on at least half of the 8 probes it is systematic and a fidelity revision is designed; if it drops only the known t22-style case the defect stays local and no mechanism claim is made
